hyro_minimum_trading_day_semantics.previous_v05_interpretation: V0.5 could be read as requiring the same trade to be opened and closed on the qualifying day.
hyro_minimum_trading_day_semantics.corrected_current_official_interpretatio: A trading day is counted from a trade exit. A day qualifies if at least one trade is executed and closed on that day regardless of holding period, and at least one position is opened on that trading day. Therefore a multi-day position may supply the qualifying close while another position opened that day satisfies the opening requirement; the same trade need not both open and close that day.
hyro_minimum_trading_day_semantics.scientific_impact: This correction is frozen before any prop replay/risk-grid outcome and prevents a false structural rejection of multi-day DH-03 positions.
